name: a11y-component-examples
description: A reference library of WCAG 2.2 AA accessible UI components in vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — copy-paste ready for any framework.

scripts.//install:skill: Run once after cloning, to use this library from OTHER repos. Links .claude/skills/a11y-library into ~/.claude/skills/ (junction on Windows, symlink elsewhere) and writes ~/.claude/a11y-library.local.json naming this clone. The skill then loads in every repo on this machine. Writes nothing inside this repo. Needs no npm install first — node builtins only.
scripts.//install:agents-md: For agents that do not read .claude/. Adds a pointer block to another project's AGENTS.md, naming this clone and the hosted URL. Usage: npm run install:agents-md -- ../other-repo (the -- is what passes the path through npm). With no path, prints the block to stdout.
scripts.//uninstall:skill: Removes the ~/.claude/skills/a11y-library link. Keeps the config, with the removal recorded in its history.
scripts.verify: npm run check:tokens && npm run check:agents && npm run build && npm run test
